description: Take back the stake of one of your Dice Club bets that the house's keeper failed to settle by its deadline (~24h after placing): the program refunds the stake (and the bet account's rent), no roll. Only the oldest unsettled bet on the table can be refunded, and only once past its deadline — both are checked before sending. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

nonce.description: the bet's nonce (get_dice_bets lists your pending bets)

name: refund_dice_bet
title: Refund an overdue Dice Club bet
